tips.title: Tip jar
tips.heading: Buy the developer a coffee?
tips.intro: My Expenses Book is free, with no ads and no tracking. That won't change. If it makes your receipts easier to deal with, you can treat the developer to a coffee.
tips.standardNote: Fuel for a late-night bug fix.
tips.generousNote: Extra energy for the next update.
tips.optional: Tips are entirely optional. Nothing is locked, with or without a tip.
tips.thanks: Thank you so much! Your coffee means a lot and helps keep this app independent.
tips.unavailable: Tips aren't available right now. Check your connection and try again.
tips.failed: The purchase didn't go through. You weren't charged.
tips.pending: Your payment is pending. The tip completes once the store confirms it.
tips.finishLater: Your tip went through. It finishes the next time you open the tip jar.

scan.title: Add receipts
scan.body: Tap + to scan a paper receipt, import a photo, or add one by hand. The app reads the merchant, date and total for you.

review.title: Check and save
review.body: Check what the app read, then save. A field marked "Check this" is one the app wasn't sure about.

totals.title: See your totals
totals.body: Home shows this pay cycle and this tax year in your home currency. Tap the slip for statistics.

bar.text: New: a short guide to pay cycle and tax year.

payCycle.title: Pay cycle
payCycle.summary: Pick the day you get paid. "This month" on Home then runs from payday to the day before the next payday. Pick 1 to use calendar months.
payCycle.body:
Only days 1–28, because every month has them, so your cycle never skips in February. Paid at the very end of the month? Pick 1.

Used by Home and Statistics. Exports and search use calendar months.

taxYear.title: Tax year
taxYear.summary: The month your tax year starts. It sets the "Tax year" total on Home, the tax-year folders and the export presets.
taxYear.body: Most countries start in January. Some start in April or July. Check with your tax office if unsure.

homeCurrency.title: Home currency
homeCurrency.summary: Totals and reports use this currency. Receipts in other currencies are converted.
homeCurrency.body: Conversion uses the exchange rate of the receipt's date, downloaded when you're online. Until a rate is available, a receipt is counted as "not converted".

lockAfter.title: Lock after
lockAfter.summary: How long the app can be in the background before it asks you to unlock again.
lockAfter.body: "Immediately" is the safest. Longer times are handy when you switch apps often, for example to copy a reference number.

unconverted.title: Not converted
unconverted.summary: Receipts in another currency that don't have an exchange rate yet. They're left out of totals so the totals stay accurate.
unconverted.body: Rates download automatically when you're online. You can also enter a rate yourself when you edit the receipt.

pace.title: Pace
pace.summary: Compares what you've spent so far with the same number of days in the last period.
pace.body: "↑ 12% vs October to day 14" means you've spent 12% more by day 14 than you had by day 14 of October.
